name: F.M.I.E Signature Oxford Navy Polo
description: A long-staple Pima cotton polo in deep imperial navy, cut for boardroom and travel alike. The F.M.I.E monogram is embroidered in gold thread over the heart at 8,000 stitches, and the placket is finished with mother-of-pearl effect buttons.
detail: Embroidered F.M.I.E monogram in brand gold, 8,000-stitch density
Self-fabric collar with internal navy tape to hold its shape
Side vents and a slightly longer back hem for a clean tuck
Pre-washed to reduce shrinkage below 2%
Woven F.M.I.E label at the inner side seam
careNotes: Machine wash cold, inside out. Do not iron directly on the embroidery.

name: F.M.I.E Executive Heavyweight Hoodie
description: A 400gsm brushed navy cotton hoodie with a structured double-layer hood, metal-tipped drawcords and a discreet debossed monogram on the left cuff. Built for long-haul travel and cold newsroom floors.
material: 80% ring-spun cotton, 20% recycled polyester, 400gsm brushed fleece
detail: Double-layer hood with navy flat drawcords and metal aglets
Kangaroo pocket with an internal phone sleeve
Debossed F.M.I.E monogram on the left cuff
Ribbed cuffs and hem knitted at 3x1 for shape retention
Fleece brushed on the reverse for warmth without bulk
careNotes: Machine wash cold with like colours. Reshape while damp and dry flat.

name: F.M.I.E Classic Debossed Cap
description: A six-panel structured cap in navy cotton twill with a debossed F.M.I.E monogram on the front panel and a gold metal closure. Pre-curved peak, sweat-wicking inner band.
detail: Debossed F.M.I.E monogram, no print to crack or peel
Six-panel construction with reinforced front buckram
Gold-tone metal slider closure
Pre-curved peak with eight rows of stitching
Moisture-wicking inner sweatband
careNotes: Spot clean only. Do not machine wash — the structured front panel will lose shape.

name: F.M.I.E Hardcover Executive Notebook & Brass Pen Set
description: A 240-page numbered notebook bound in navy board with a gold foil monogram, paired with a solid brass barrel pen. Presented in a rigid gift box with a ribbon pull.
material: 120gsm numbered cream paper, navy binder board, solid brass
detail: 240 numbered pages on 120gsm cream stock, lay-flat section-sewn binding
Gold foil F.M.I.E monogram on the front board
Solid brass barrel pen, refillable standard international cartridge
Inner pocket, elastic closure and twin ribbon markers
Rigid gift box with ribbon pull

name: F.M.I.E Matte Ceramic Executive Mug
description: A 350ml matte navy ceramic mug with a white interior and a fired-in gold monogram. Weighted base, comfortable handle, dishwasher safe.
detail: 350ml capacity, weighted base for desk stability
Matte navy exterior, bright white interior
Fired-in gold F.M.I.E monogram, not a surface transfer
Dishwasher and microwave safe
Packed in a moulded pulp sleeve

name: F.M.I.E Italian Leather Laptop Folio
description: A full-grain Italian leather folio sized for 16-inch laptops, with a suede-lined device sleeve, document pockets, card slots and a debossed F.M.I.E monogram on the front panel.
material: Full-grain vegetable-tanned Italian leather, suede lining
detail: Fits laptops up to 16 inches in a suede-lined suspended sleeve
Two document pockets, six card slots and a pen loop
Debossed F.M.I.E monogram on the front panel
Solid brass hardware and hand-burnished edges
Detachable shoulder strap with padded leather shoulder guard
careNotes: Condition with a neutral leather cream twice a year. Patina is expected and intended.
